title: Introduce rate-limiter smoothing, egress soft-deny probe, and regional telemetry guard
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: During an intermittent incident on 2026-02-12 we observed rapid oscillation between normal and soft-deny states in regional egress when transient backend latency spikes coincided with bursty tenant traffic. That interaction exposed two issues: (1) the token-based rate limiter emits sharp step changes that produce aggressive load-shedding decisions, and (2) the regional health probe lacked hysteresis causing frequent region failover toggles. This PR introduces three coordinated mitigations: a lightweight smoothing layer for rate limits (EMWA-based), an 'egress soft-deny probe' that allows a short probationary holding pattern before full soft-deny enforcement, and a telemetry guard that prevents automated failovers when we detect probe/metric oscillation patterns. Summary of changes: - runtime/shedder/smoother.go: new smoothing wrapper around the existing leaky-bucket limiter using an exponential moving weighted average (configurable alpha) to soften ramp-up/ramp-down. - runtime/egress/soft_deny_probe.go: probationary probe that tracks transient rejection rates and only flips soft-deny on sustained windows; supports configurable window and grace counters. - telemetry/region_guard.go: guard that computes oscillation score from region-probe and egress metrics and inhibits automated regional failover if score exceeds threshold; emits guard telemetry for SRE dashboards. - k8s/patches/egress-configmap.yaml: runtime defaults and feature flag toggles to stage rollout. - tests/integration/egress_smoothing_test.go: new integration and deterministic fuzz tests that simulate bursty tenants + backend hitches. - docs/ops/egress-smoothing.md: runbook, rollout, and rollback steps. Backwards compatibility: all features are behind feature flags and conservative defaults (alpha=0.25, probation window=30s, oscillation threshold high). Rollout plan: canary 25% (us-west-2) for 2 hours, then region-by-region rollout with a 2-hour observation window and a quick rollback playbook. Hotfix rationale: this was prioritized as an incident-driven hotfix (SUP-4523) because oscillation previously caused two small regional failovers within a 45m window. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for smoothing math and boundary conditions - [x] Integration test that reproduces previously-observed oscillation in CI fuzz harness - [x] Updated runbook and alert thresholds - [x] Telemetry events wired and dashboard updated - [x] Feature flag gating for progressive rollout Deploy notes: flip feature flag to canary, observe metrics: region.failover.count, egress.soft_deny.rate, shedder.smoothing.alpha; if regional oscillation returns, revert flag and tag incident for deeper root cause. Related: ENG-7891 (rate-limiter stability), SRE-141 (egress incident postmortem).
